findings.rationale: Real: an unprobed override defeats KR4. Folded section 2.5: every candidate incl. AUTOPILOT_LIVE_DIR is probed; a rejected override is skipped; test ext4-override + tmpfs-candidate => tmpfs chosen.

Real: alphabet + length is not an algorithm. Folded section 2.5: getSessionId() made normative (per-scalar replace with underscore, first 64 scalars, empty => unknown) plus shared vector file hooks/tests/fixtures/session-id-vectors.json for Rust and Node.

Real: rename is atomic replacement, not synchronisation. Folded: two files, one writer each (<sid>.json main, <sid>.tasks.json subagent), no read-modify-write; section 3, P1.3 and section 6 rewritten.
Real: one written_at cannot cover two independently refreshed sections. Folded: per-file written_at, a reader checks only the file it uses (section 2.5 freshness, P2.3).

Real contradiction. Folded section 2.6: existing hooks byte-identical (exit/stdout/stderr) against a pinned v2.36.0 fixture when no usable live file exists; state-file location moves only when a RAM dir exists (owner requirement); the delegate gate is declared as new default-on behaviour and block requires a fresh live model. The sub-repair that the gate must stay silent without a live file is refuted: the nudge without model knowledge is the purpose of the gate; it is new stderr by design and is now stated as such.

Real gap. Folded section 0: v2.32.56 scaleTiers already scales non-explicit tiers to the window (named tests cited); decision formula t1 = explicit ?? round(100000*W/200000), t2 = explicit ?? round(150000*W/200000) stated; the plan changes only the source of W, so the 2026-07-14 ruling is not reopened.

Real: fallback fields were absent from the schema. Folded: tasks schema carries cwd and startTime; P0 is a precondition of P1 and must produce a mapping contract (id equality or exact (model,cwd,startTime) match) with 0 or >=2 rows => fail-open plus a stderr diagnostic.

Real: fable vs claude-fable-5-1 would never match. Folded section 2.5: family(id) parser defined with three worked examples, exact family membership, single implementation in scripts/lib/live-state-dir.js; P3 tests list positive, negative, near-match, case, malformed, stale and absent cases.

Real: a version field without an acceptance rule guards nothing. Folded section 2.5: readers accept integer 1 only, anything else => treated as absent; P2.2 tests cover version 2, missing and malformed.
